{"script":"mkdir -p temp_workspace
cp /etc/group temp_workspace/group_raw.txt
awk 'NF && $0 !~ /^#/ {sub(/^[ \t]+/,""); sub(/[ \t]+$/,""); print}' temp_workspace/group_raw.txt > temp_workspace/group_clean.txt
cut -d: -f1 temp_workspace/group_clean.txt > temp_workspace/group_names.txt
sort -u temp_workspace/group_names.txt > temp_workspace/group_unique_sorted.txt
empty_count=$(grep -c '^$' temp_workspace/group_unique_sorted.txt || true)
malformed_count=$(grep -nE '[[:space:]:]' temp_workspace/group_unique_sorted.txt | wc -l || true)
total=$(wc -l < temp_workspace/group_unique_sorted.txt)
# write ready_for_count.txt with names and integrity note
cp temp_workspace/group_unique_sorted.txt temp_workspace/ready_for_count.txt
printf "# Integrity: unique=%d empty=%d malformed=%d\n" "$total" "$empty_count" "$malformed_count" >> temp_workspace/ready_for_count.txt
# compute good count (exclude empties and malformed)
good=$((total - empty_count - malformed_count))
echo "$good""}
